fixed.problem: L4-chat-201: after one cheap stronger answer anywhere on the install, every later Go ahead under 'This needs a stronger model ...' showed the same ask again and ran nothing (live check 4, LC-C14).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts 'l4-chat-depth, run L4: a Go ahead runs the answer it offered (L4-chat-201)' (3 cases); apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-chat-depth, run L4' > 'POST /chat: Go ahead under use a stronger model: runs Sonnet once, and again after cheap stronger answers ...'
fixed.how: Root cause: atMostOf stored max(2x estimate, floor) with the floor unrounded, and the Go ahead's own turn measured a floor a few hundred micro-USD higher, so personsPass always asked again. Now the stored 'at most' is the CHF shown on the line, rounded up to the centime (usdMicroOfCentimes); a yes is judged as shown (yesCovers, whole centimes) and asks again only when the model changed or the shown figure would change; the pass budget is the yes's 'at most' capped by the room. Same comparison for the person's own amount (Think it through).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Chat tab: 'use a stronger model: compare the two ways to write the FAQ' -> ask line with Go ahead; press Go ahead -> 'Thought it through with Sonnet · ...'. Ask a second stronger question later and press Go ahead again: it runs again, no repeated ask line.

fixed.problem: L4-chat-202: the real fast model never called answer_thoroughly (0 of 7 in LC-C13); it asked 'Should I go ahead?' in its own words, which the app could not act on.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts 'l4-chat-depth, run L4: the fast model's hand-over is never left to words (L4-chat-202)'; real-daemon 'l4-chat-depth, run L4' answer-alone case (stand-in FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_ALONE)
fixed.how: Words: the thinking_longer fact and ANSWER_THOROUGHLY_DESCRIPTION say who acts ('call answer_thoroughly; the app asks the person with the cost (never ask in your own words)'); conversation-agent 1.5.0 says the same and scopes 'Thinking longer' to the quick answer. Ask-only backstop (ADR 0114 amended 2026-11-22): a typed quick answer without the tool on a line that shows a need (needOfLine, EN+DE, outside quotes) or whose reply asks in words (offersInWords) runs the gate in code; when the rung asks first the reply carries the app's own StoredOffer with Go ahead and the words' ask is removed (withoutWordsOffer). A rung that would go ahead is never started by words. Stand-in mode FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_ALONE plays the live model.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Chat tab: 'make a plan for the next two sessions' -> under the answer the app's line 'This needs a stronger model: about CHF … (at most CHF …) and … seconds. Go ahead?' with a Go ahead button; never 'Should I go ahead?' as plain text. Press Go ahead -> one Sonnet answer.

fixed.problem: L4-chat-203: the paid Sonnet pass said 'I couldn't hand it to the stronger model' under 'Thought it through with Sonnet': it reused the quick pass's facts.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts 'l4-chat-depth, run L4: the paid closer look is told what it is (L4-chat-203)'
fixed.how: thoroughPass gets its own facts line this_answer (thoroughFact: '... the closer look on Sonnet that the person said yes to (at most CHF 0.57)', or asked for / handed over) in place of thinking_longer; CHAT_THOROUGH_RULES opens 'You are the closer look ...' and says answer_thoroughly and 'Thinking longer' are the quick answer's; carries the look-it-up sentence and 'say in plain words what you could not check'. The fast request is byte-identical.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Chat: 'use a stronger model: why does <a failed task> keep failing?' -> Go ahead -> the Sonnet answer never says it could not hand the question over or that a stronger model was not used.

fixed.problem: L4-chat-205: past 12 turns the history window slid by one turn, so every chat request re-sent the history uncached (prompt cache read only tools and system).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts 'l4-chat-depth, run L4: the history is read from the prompt cache (L4-chat-205)' (13 turns; long replies under 12; composed twice)
fixed.how: Stepped window, a pure function of stored rows: chat.human rows keep a turn number (turn, nextTurnNumber); the window starts at floor((n-12)/6)*6 (12-17 turns) and the token cap drops whole steps; same for the thorough pass and after a restart.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Not visible as a screen; on bench-live the session lead reads the model-call log: after 13+ chat turns, consecutive quick lines within five minutes show cache reads covering the history (LC-C12).

fixed.how: task.dependencies.run appends one line: still waiting -> 'It runs after it is done, at your next Start.' (previewWork, read-only); made runnable -> prepared (withNextLine: joins a running session if it fits, else 'It runs at your next Start.'); already runnable -> previewWork's line. IntentParser reads 'let X run on its own' / 'make X wait for nothing' as depends_on []. Fake daemon mirrors.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Chat: 'make "Write the FAQ" wait for "Write the README"' -> Yes -> '"Write the FAQ" now waits for "Write the README". It runs after it is done, at your next Start.'; then 'let "Write the FAQ" run on its own' -> Yes -> '"Write the FAQ" waits for no other task now. It runs at your next Start.' Same words from the Tasks drawer's Change what it waits for.

new_problems: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts is over Biome's 1 MiB files.maxSize, so pnpm lint skips it with a warning (no format or lint check on that file); pre-existing, grows with every area.

The real daemon's GET /conversation sends an older turn's offer with action null but keeps the ask line (or the ask-only reply as text); the past-tense wording is done only in the desktop UI's Conversation.tsx. Any other surface that renders the conversation view (e.g. the phone app later) would still show 'Go ahead?' on old lines unless it reuses pastOfferLine or the daemon words it.

With FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_ALONE=1 the stand-in's 'make a plan for the next two sessions' reply is only an ask in words, so after the backstop the reply is the ask line itself (no answer text). True to the live model's behaviour in LC-C13, but the person then gets no quick answer at all for that line; LC-C13 on bench-live should check whether the real model answers something before asking.

The fake daemon's chat_ask_above branch was dead (SETTING_RISK did not name the key) until L4-chat-211; other keys may have the same drift: SETTING_RISK should be checked against SETTING_SPECS once (a test that every SETTING_SPECS key is in the fake's table).
notes_for_other_areas: chat.human rows now carry `turn` (the turn number from the conversation's start; nextTurnNumber in transcript.ts) - one field added in l4-cred-screens' write region of agent.ts; historyMessages uses a stepped window (HISTORY_STEP_TURNS=6, 12-17 turns).

depth.ts new exports: usdMicroOfCentimes, atMostOf (centime-rounded), yesCovers, needOfLine, offersInWords, withoutWordsOffer, thoroughFact; thinkingLongerFact texts changed ('available: call answer_thoroughly; the app ...'); askAboveWords removed; CHAT_THOROUGH_RULES now opens 'You are the closer look' and carries L4-chat-106's look-it-up sentence (l4-chat-answers should not add it again).
SessionBudget.wrapReasonOf(runId): 'line' | 'now' (append-only) - use it to tell a spend wrap-up from Answer now.
conversation-agent principal is 1.5.0 ('Thinking longer' says the app writes the ask; scoped to the quick answer). l4-chat-answers (L4c) and l4-selftasks-chat (L4f) bump from 1.5.0.
Stand-in: FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_ALONE=1 (BenchOptions.chatAlone) makes the role player answer alone and ask in words, like live check 4's fast model; use it for any test of the hand-over.

commands: executor.confirm re-checks closedProjectRefusal on the stored card; restorePending arms closed-project cards; server.ts closedProjectAnswer + refuseClosedData middleware on /projects/:id/data and /data/import; IntentParser reads 'let X run on its own' / 'make X wait for nothing' as task.dependencies depends_on [].

task.dependencies' result sentence now ends with when the task runs ('It runs after it is done, at your next Start.', 'It runs at your next Start.', or the join line); any test pinning the old sentence needs the tail.
session.start money uses chfExact ('(up to CHF 5.00)') on the read-back, the done sentence and the card's newValue.
settings: chat_ask_above's words are the amount alone; the meaning of 0 is the spec's `effect`. The fake daemon's SETTING_RISK now has chat_ask_above.
Conversation.tsx exports pastOfferLine(line, taken); Turn takes a `taken` prop (tookOffer of the next turn).

Real-daemon describe 'l4-chat-depth, run L4' sits at the end of apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts with its open() helper (role player + composeRuntime); besides the two shared_files assertions (:4327, :15559) this area also changed :894 (the Tasks tab dependency sentence) for L4-chat-207.
